g.text: Multicollinearity: when two predictors carry the same information

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: The fit can be good while the separate slopes are very unstable.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: Perfect duplicates (Celsius and Fahrenheit, kg and g) make the coefficients impossible to separate.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Near duplicates make them unstable. A high VIF is a warning to think, not an automatic order to delete a predictor.
